segment.target: In the data access tick the login with the name, the email address and the phone number, press "Continue", then confirm
Open https://oauth.yandex.ru/client/new/id/, fill in the service name and the contact email and press "Continue"
Copy ClientID from the app page into "Application ID" and Client secret into "Application secret"
In the platforms tick web services, enter {url} into "Redirect URI" and press "Continue"
